html:
From 1998 militias from Guadalcanal and Malaita fought over land and jobs around Honiara, a period called the Tensions. In 2000 a Malaitan militia forced the prime minister out at gunpoint.

The state nearly collapsed. In 2003 the Regional Assistance Mission to Solomon Islands (RAMSI), led by Australia with New Zealand and Pacific states, arrived to disarm militias and rebuild the police and courts.

RAMSI collected thousands of guns and stayed until 2017. It was the largest Pacific-led intervention of its kind. Unrest returned in 2021 riots, after which the Solomon Islands turned to China for security help. Compare the Bougainville war next door.
